API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Remove
Groups Ops Remove
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups/:id

Deletes an existing group based on the provided group ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the group to be deleted.

Responses
​
204
401

The group was successfully deleted.

No content is returned in the response, but headers may be useful for validation purposes.
